name: heterogeneous-node-lowering

protocol.note: GPU bucket assignment uses atomic_fetch_add, so per-bucket slot order is thread-arrival order. Selected node classes are compared against reference::select_tier2_nodes as a sorted multiset, never by GPU slot position. Default Metal path is bucket compute + per-Node dispatchThreadgroupsWithIndirectBuffer; the host does not read bucket counts before those indirect dispatches. ICB is an optional capability upgrade and is not used. A post-wait readback (last_selected_node_classes) is verification only.

correctness.tolerance: exact (sorted multiset of selected node classes; unauthorized class is a hard refuse)

judgement: Metal selects among two pre-authorized Node classes with a GPU bucket kernel plus one indirect dispatch per class. The selected-class multiset matches the CPU oracle on uniform (4+4) and skewed (7+1) 8-task graphs. An unauthorized class is refused. The report carries bucket/command counts and is classified EmulatedDevicePass -- not DevicePass -- because no native ICB select ran. The reference backend host-walks the same graph and reports Serialized. Tier3 (GPU invents a Node / grows the envelope) is not implemented and stays Unsupported. No hitch or cost curve is claimed; D7 records break-even as unmeasured.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/038/041); comments in vulkan_device_hal.{h,cpp} document DGC-or-bucket as the analogue and are not wired to request_tier2_select
